title.zh: 将北甘马粦省 Mercedes 市镇的 Basud 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Manguisoc 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Basud National High School - Manguisoc High School Annex in the Municipality of Mercedes, Province of Camarines Norte from the Basud National High School and Converting the same into an Independent National High School to be known as the Manguisoc National High School, and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Basud National High School - Manguisoc High School Annex in the Municipality of Mercedes, Province of Camarines Norte from the Basud National High School and Converting the same into an Independent National High School to be known as the Manguisoc National High School, and appropriating funds therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Manguisoc High School của Trường Trung học Basud Quốc gia tại Đô thị Mercedes, Tỉnh Camarines Norte khỏi Trường Trung học Basud Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Manguisoc Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Manguisoc High School ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Basud แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Mercedes จังหวัด Camarines Norte ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Basud แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Manguisoc แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Manguisoc High School, Sekolah Menengah Basud Nasional di Kotamadya Mercedes, Provinsi Camarines Norte dari Sekolah Menengah Basud Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Manguisoc Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Manguisoc High School, Sekolah Menengah Basud Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Mercedes, Wilayah Camarines Norte daripada Sekolah Menengah Basud Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Manguisoc Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Basud National High School - Manguisoc High School Annex in the Municipality of Mercedes, Province of Camarines Norte, is hereby separated from the Basud National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Manguisoc National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Basud National High School - Manguisoc High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Manguisoc National High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Basud National High School - Manguisoc High School Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Manguisoc National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
